title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: a bill number opens its delivery
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with Reports page access and Vendor Order Management View.
  • Vendor Y has an unpaid bill received at your current location.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Unpaid Invoices" in the left list.
  3. Open vendor Y's group.
  4. Click the bill's No.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • the delivery page of that bill opens.

Why this matters: Payables staff check the delivery before paying.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-payable/ApAgingDetailReport.vue:305-313; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-payable/ApAgingDetailReport.vue:499-508. V1 code, quoted: `void router?.push(`/parts/delivery/${transaction.referenceId}`);`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-137) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.
